senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (मयते)
To go, to move.

m. (-यः)
1 A camel.
2 A mule.
3 A demon, and the carpenter or architect of the DAITYAS.
4 Hurting, injuring.
f. (-या)
Administering remedies, the practice of physic.
E.
मय to go, or मि to scatter, or मी to hurt, aff. अच् or खल् and टाप्.

m. (-यः)
1 A mime, a juggler.
2 An Asura or evil spirit.
f. (-या)
1 Fraud, trick, deceit, illusion.
2 A female juggler.
3 Understanding, human intellect.
4 Compassion.
5 Wickedness, villainy, villainous deception.
6 A name of LAKṢMĪ.
7 Trick in negotiation, political fraud, diplomacy.
8 Philosophical illusion, idealism, unreality of all worldly existence; personified in mythology as a female, the consort of BRAHMĀ or GOD, and the immediate and active cause of creation.
9 The mother of BUDDHA.
E.
मा to measure, Uṇādi aff. य; the medium through which all things are seen, and by which they are estimated.

m. (-टः)
A hut of grass or leaves.
E.
मय to go, अटच् aff.

m. (-युः)
1 A Kinnara or chorister of Svarga.
2 A deer.
E.
मि to scatter, (sweet sounds, &c.,) Uṇādi aff. उ.

m. (-युः)
Bile, the bilious humour.
E.
मि to scatter or diffuse, (through the body,) उण् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-जः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
मयु a Kinnara, and राज chief; having these beings attached especially to his court and capital.

m. (-जः)
The son of KUVERA.

m. (-कः)
A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
E.
मय to go, aff. उ, मयु one who goes, ष्टक to impede, aff. ड, मयुष्ट, and with the pleonastic addition, कुन् मयुष्टक; also with अच् aff. after मय to go, मयष्ट, and मयष्टक; and again with प substituted for म, मपष्ट, मपष्टक, मपुष्ट or मपुष्टक.

m. (-खः)
1 Light, lustre, brightness.
2 A ray of light.
3 Flame.
4 Beauty.
5 The pin or gnomon of a sun-dial.
E.
मा to measure, (time, &c.,) ऊख Uṇādi aff., and मय substituted for the root.

m. (-रः)
1 A peacock.
2 A flower, the coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.)
3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)
f. (-री)
1 A peahen.
2 A potherb, (Basella rubra, &c.)
E.
मि to scatter, Uṇādi aff. ऊरन् or मही the earth in the seventh case, मह्यां, रु to cry, ड aff., and the formation irr.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Belonging to a peacock, made of its feathers, &c.
n. (-रं)
A flock of peacocks.
E.
मयूर a peacock, and अण् aff. of multitude, &c.

m. (-कः)
1 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)
2 A flower, (Celosia cristata.)
3 A peacock.
n. (-कं)
Blue vitriol.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A house or dunghill cock.

f. (-डा)
Coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.)
E.
मयूर a peacock, and चूडा the comb or crest.

n. (-कं)
A sort of scratch with a finger nail.
E.
मयूर a peacock, पद a foot, and कन् aff. implying resemblance.

m. (-रिः)
A chameleon, a lizard.
E.
मयूर a peacock, and अरि the enemy.

m. (-रः)
A juggler, a mime, an actor.
E.
माया trick or delusion, and कार who makes.

m. (-कृत्)
A juggler.
E.
माया trick, and कृत् who practices.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Illusive, deceptive.
E.
माया, and चणष् aff.

m. (-वी)
A conjurer, a juggler.
E.
माया trick, and जीविन् who lives by.

m. (-दः)
A crocodile, an alligator.
E.
माया illusion, and द who gives or makes.

m. (-तः)
BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect.
E.
मायादेवी the goddess MĀYĀ or illusion, and सुत son.

mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु)
Delusive, expert in deceiving.
E.
माया, and पटु clever.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Illusive, deceptive.
E.
माया, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Deceptive, illusory.
m. (-वान्)
A name of KAṂSA.
f. (-वती)
The wife of KĀMA.
E.
माया fraud, illusion, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-कः)
A deceiver, a cheater, a liar.
E.
माया fraud, वस to abide, aff. ठक्.

m. (-वी)
1 A juggler, a conjurer.
2 A cat.
E.
माया trick, and विनि aff.

m. (-तः)
BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect.
E.
माया the goddess so named, and सुत the son.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Illusory, deceptive.
m. (-कः)
A juggler, a conjurer.
E.
माया trick, and ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Deceptive, illusory.
m. (-यी)
1 A conjurer, a juggler.
2 A cheat, a deceiver.
3 ŚIVA.
4 AGNI.
5 BRAHMĀ.
6 KĀMA or love.
E.
माया fraud, &c., and इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
A hunter or killer of peacocks.
E.
मयूर a peacock, and ठक् aff.
